item.title: Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce Still Haven’t Told Guests Where Their Wedding Will Be, George Kittle Says
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about the upcoming wedding of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce. Join me as we explore the latest updates on their big day.
[Music transitions]
Host: So, it seems like Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are keeping their wedding location under wraps, even from their guests. According to George and Claire Kittle, who received an invitation to the wedding, they have no idea where the ceremony will take place. In fact, George Kittle joked that he's half expecting to be put on a plane to a mystery location.
[Short music clip]
Host: The Kittles did confirm that they'll be attending the wedding, but that's about all they know. There have been reports that the wedding will take place in New York City over Fourth of July Weekend, but nothing has been officially confirmed.
[Music transitions]
Host: In other news, Travis Kelce and George Kittle have been hosting their annual Tight End University, a charity event that brings together NFL tight ends for training and fundraising. This year's event included a concert, where Taylor Swift made a surprise appearance, performing a duet of "Love Story" with Lainey Wilson.
[Short music clip]
Host: George Kittle had nothing but praise for Travis Kelce, saying that he's always looking out for Taylor Swift and is a loyal partner. It's clear that the two couples are close friends, and we can't wait to see what the future holds for them.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's podcast. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
